environment.description: Same EKS 1.27 cluster but namespace 'docpreview-prod' has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (Kubernetes Pod Security Standards at 'restricted' level). The restricted profile rejects pods with spec.containers[*].securityContext.privileged=true, spec.volumes[*].hostPath, runAsNonRoot must be true, and drops ALL capabilities. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-volume-types' with validationFailureAction: Enforce denies any pod spec containing hostPath or projected volumes referencing service account tokens with audience other than 'vault'. Node-level IMDSv2-only enforcement via EC2 launch template HttpTokens=required with hop limit 1 (blocking container IMDS access since pod network adds a hop).

config.network_policy: default-deny-egress with allowlist for partner1.example.com and cdn.example.com on port 443 only
